identity_rules: Stable surface identities are references to editor, dashboard, chat, terminal section, workgroup, pane, session, and buffer owners.
Movement, docking, resize, close, reopen, and reload do not mint buffers, browser sessions, chats, terminal sessions, or PTYs.
Invalid or corrupt envelopes reset safely and record a reason; off-screen floating bounds recover to last_docked_host or home_main.

interaction_authority.state_rule: DOM and Slint controls project committed/draft model state; Pointer Events transactions preview locally and dispatch/persist once at semantic drop or resize end.
interaction_rules: Pointer capture, offset-preserving pickup, placeholder/reflow preview, edge-zone cues, cancellation, reduced-motion, and save-on-drop semantics are preserved from U10 vocabulary.
Four-edge scroll dissolve and the shared theme-aware resizer glow/recovery remain the common systems.
Web guarantees in-canvas floating and all four in-app docks; window.open is optional degraded behavior.

The 28 by 28 More options trigger sits immediately left of Theme and opens exactly Open Panel, Open Browser in Panel, a divider, Collapse Bottom Terminal, and Reset Layout; the Collapse row is a toggle (tweak wave 2026-08-13: runtime relabel to Expand Bottom Terminal while collapsed, one cmd.workspace_layout.set_collapsed with the negated current value per activation).
Open Panel and Open Browser in Panel are view-local disclosures; only Panel 1 through Panel 4 leaves dispatch commands. Collapse Bottom Terminal is never relabeled as Expand.

Reset is dual-surface (amended 2026-08-13): Settings > General & Appearance > Startup & Recovery and the top-bar Reset Layout row both dispatch cmd.workspace_layout.reset with no new command ID; the concept demo's post-reset reload is demo behavior only. Move or Dock remains retired and File Manager targeting remains File Manager-local.

Movement is direct manipulation from the top-right lines-only grip (tweak wave 2026-08-13; the corner triangle is retired): the held surface tracks the pointer one-to-one, the placeholder projects the TARGET geometry (fair share of the destination host; full width plus track thickness in row-axis docks) and re-seats only on a host or insertion-index change (one FLIP reflow wave per change, 16 ms stagger). A pickup still inside the source rect resolves to the source placement and a preview-expanded host never captures the hit-test for its preview growth. Preview never re-renders a surface subtree. Hosts carry visible-surface caps (left/right 3, top/bottom 2, floating 4, home_main uncapped) with announced host_full refusal; normalization spills overflow to home_main and never quarantines.

The centre-screen drop-target rail is retired. Drop targeting resolves surface-under-pointer, then outer edge band (the only route to a currently empty, zero-sized dock), then host-under-pointer, then home_main. Amended 2026-08-13: leaving the window resolves to invalid_target — floating is explicit-only through the Pop Out rows (editor panels, Chat, Dashboard) or the keyboard float key, and boot demotes persisted floating surfaces to last_docked_host with a storage.boot_demote_floating receipt.
Loss of pointer capture is not a cancellation vector: live reflow re-parents projected items and drops capture. Escape, pointer cancellation and window blur are the cancellation contract.

Resize is adjacent-pair pixel transfer with fair-share minimum degradation, unified host bands, a floating bottom-right corner handle, commit without a full re-render, and the render-time no-dead-space invariant; the tweak wave adds row-axis dock two-axis sizing - within-row pair width transfer on the column dividers plus a full-width track handle writing the persisted size.cross_basis_px field (host-max semantics, host-band clamped, migrated from basis_px). A commit that moves zero pixels is a failure.
Keyboard movement on the grab handle is the accessible equivalent of the pointer gesture and carries the contract the retired menu rows used to hold, announced through a polite live region.

The grab handle is a small lines-only glyph (two diagonal strokes, no filled plate) over an 18 px clip-path hit triangle at the surface's TOP-RIGHT corner; the empty half falls through, focus renders in-glyph, and ARIA plus the keyboard grammar are unchanged. The surface kebab menus carry no Placement section or hint.

The base full-screen chat overlay is retired in PM7: every non-docked chat mode routes through PM_HOME_WORKSPACE.popOutChat into the single in-canvas float system (no scrim, title bar never covered, no second chat surface).

dock_right spans the full workspace height (grid areas 'top top right' / 'left main right' / 'bottom bottom right'); top and bottom docks end at the right column. Move Workgroup to New Section reseeds the vacated source section in the same commit (guidance state at the four-pane cap), and reset reconstitutes a live workgroup.

retired_rows_2026_08_12.disposition: Retired with the per-surface Move or dock menu inventory. cmd.workspace_layout.move_surface is unchanged and is dispatched from home.<surface>.grab (pointer and keyboard) and home.drop_target.<host>.
